scope.dimension_policy: Exactly six current dimensions; historical rubrics do not define current coverage.

target.pin_policy: Resolve GitHub stable and npm latest together before a campaign; pin version, release commit and package integrity for its duration. Historical bootstrap runs are excluded from current-release conclusions.

historical_reference.change_policy: Keep every V6 archived file unchanged.

required_before_execution: Implement and independently validate OpenClaw adapters and task acceptance fixtures for each selected case.
Declare a whole-run disk and inode budget, shared dependency budget, and cleanup ownership manifest.
Set per-case time, memory, process, and connection limits.
Pre-register independent-unit counts, workload sizes, failure boundaries, and stopping rules.
Any real-model confirmation requires a separately defined budget; historical authorization text is not inherited.
Pin the OpenClaw runtime, model/provider, plugin revisions and capability support; do not run Hermes controllers.

reporting.rule: No product scores or architectural causal claims are generated from design completeness or CI success.
reporting.missing_measurements: Use null with an explicit reason; missing, unsupported and harness errors are never zero, passes or completed product measurements.

experiments.title: Extension replacement during active work
experiments.mechanism: Registration and disable operations can affect new dispatches differently from already running calls.
experiments.intervention: Install, update, disable, and uninstall the same extension while one invocation is paused.
experiments.oracle: Verify documented lifecycle semantics and state ownership; record how many core changes or private patches are required.
controls: Use the pinned OpenClaw revision, documented entry point and recorded effective permissions.
Hold model transcripts and external service work fixed for deterministic mechanism tests.
Retain baseline and intervention evidence separately; never score a patched runtime as the baseline.
Record unsupported capabilities explicitly; do not invent an integration or silently substitute another product.

experiments.title: Full harness replacement versus provider routing
experiments.mechanism: Delegating to a model provider or external tool may leave the original agent loop and state ownership intact.
experiments.intervention: Integrate the same reference external harness through each documented route and trace ownership end to end.
experiments.oracle: Identify the owner of planning, tool selection, checkpoints, cancellation, and result commits; do not label all routes equivalent harness support.

experiments.oracle: Judge against the actual compatibility promise and explicit rejection behavior, not arbitrary cross-version expectations.

dimensions.name: Observability

experiments.title: Authorization decision reconstruction
experiments.mechanism: An allowed verdict can omit whether the approval was single-use, session-scoped, persistent, inherited, or policy-derived.
experiments.intervention: Exercise each declared approval mode and reconstruct actor, target, policy version, and scope using product records alone.
experiments.oracle: A reviewer must identify the actual authorization choice, not merely approved versus denied; truth is held separately.

experiments.title: Collector failure and publisher durability
experiments.mechanism: A retry queue may be memory-only or durable, and a local transcript may survive when remote export does not.
experiments.intervention: Fail the collector at a matched event boundary, then restart the publisher or exhaust its declared buffer.
experiments.oracle: Compare native local records and exported events independently against event IDs; distinguish duplicate delivery from missing events.

experiments.title: Blind diagnosis of known faults
experiments.mechanism: Many log lines do not guarantee that an operator can reconstruct causal order or distinguish retries from duplicate effects.
experiments.intervention: Give a reviewer only product records for predeclared injected faults; withhold the independent truth ledger until scoring.
experiments.oracle: Score the reconstructed cause and timeline against the hidden truth; record unknown answers instead of guessing from absent logs.
